items.title: Dating girl for a while
items.text:
Dating girl for a while
Hey r/dating

So I've been dating this girl for a while and it's going pretty good.
She has a lot of fire and I'm usually quite dominant so I'm really enjoying the dynamic. She is very inexperienced so i told her it is hard sometimes for me to estimate when she is ready for some things but i told her i want to give her time. 

We're on a 5th date coming soon and i've never really experienced delaying sex for so long and it is somehow driving me insane yet somehow keeping things very spicy. Idk how to explain. 
Anyways the girl is great and all but i really have a tendency to overthink and always had. Its getting better and i really just wanted to come here for date ideas and auggestions which are more creative than cinnema etc, but just been reading the top post here and one of them was something about if somebody doesn't texts you earlier than 4 hours quit it.

This seems bizarre but also is kinda making me overthink right now. Like yeah we sometimes have that and omg is she not into me becuz somebody on the internet tells me this golden rule?!?! Since that sometimes is our dynamic. Now that i'm thinking about it i really think it ia bullshit since every relatoonship has a certain dynamic and 4 hours is not all that long at all imo. We text everyday and see each other atleast once a week. Apart from that we're both not text heavy. I guess i wanted to vent more than anything else, but i really think some of the top post on here have a very counterproductive and one sizd fits all mindset, while dating is possibly one of the most gray areas in life.

This might get removed but idc, just wanted to vent and happy to share:)
